{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面只是一个常见的心情记录表单，数据仅存浏览器、无同步，没有体现特别的产品角度、垂直场景或创意呈现；它是对已有问题的普通实现，不符合任何推送标准。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason says the page is a mood-entry form that keeps data only in the browser with no sync. The page text confirms both points ("Saved in this browser… No cloud backup or sync"), and these are concrete details of this project. It argues there is nothing distinctive, which supports the pass decision.
